topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Well, I'll be. Open up the mailbox, and there it is: a package wrapped neat as a pin, address a little smudged but still readable. Whoever the previous tenant was, they're sure missing out. The box is light, but it clinks just a bit when I shake it, which gets my interest cooking. Could be something valuable, or maybe just an old friend's greetings. Either way, there’s a story here, and I've got a hunch this could lead to some interesting places. Gonna take this back to my place, have a closer look. Sometimes, you just never know what a little mystery can turn up.
